scope: Owner-authored structural conditions in one 26-page educational demonstration website. This manifest is evaluator-only and is never published or passed to a detector or agent.

evidence_facets.exact_shared_value: A practical page checklist | Spiral Max SEO Test Lab
A practical checklist for reviewing a small educational web page before sharing it.

no_action_controls.reason: A concise privacy notice satisfies a utility purpose; low word count alone is insufficient grounds to expand it.
The interactive checklist supplies the page's utility; low prose word count alone is not a defect.
A navigation hub is useful through its curated destinations, not a prose quota.
A useful descriptive-title guide with unique metadata, a self canonical and multiple incoming links needs no seeded repair.

known_ancillary_observations.observation: The noindex URL also appears in the sitemap; this is the same exclusion condition, not a separate independent fault for scoring.
The URL with a mismatching canonical also appears in the sitemap; this is the same canonical condition, not a separate independent fault for scoring.
A true HTTP 404 is the target evidence for the broken link, not an accidentally noindexed release page.
A true HTTP 404 is the target evidence for the sitemap inconsistency, not an accidentally noindexed release page.

limits: Structural overlap is only potential cannibalisation. No query-level traffic, ranking, conversion or commercial impact is fabricated.
Owner intent establishes that the one noindex and one wrong canonical are accidental; an external crawl alone cannot establish intent.
These deterministic seeds are not evidence that the system can predict business outcomes or qualifies for Level 2.
The custom 404 page intentionally contains noindex and is outside the 26-page release inventory.
Live indexing, Search Console, GA4, rendered-browser verification and deployment rollback require separate observed evidence.
